Test Case Description: Verify valid login succeeds for authorized user
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to VWO login page
2. Enter valid email
3. Enter valid password
4. Click Sign in

Test Case Description: Verify login fails with invalid password
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to login page
2. Enter valid email
3. Enter invalid password
4. Click Sign in

Test Case Description: Verify forgot password flow initiates reset email
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to login page
2. Click Forgot Password
3. Enter registered email
4. Submit request

Test Case Description: Verify new A/B experiment can be created with valid name and URL
Test Steps:
1. Login
2. Navigate to Testing module
3. Click Create New Test
4. Enter valid experiment name
5. Enter valid URL
6. Save

Test Case Description: Verify validation error appears when experiment name is blank
Test Steps:
1. Login
2. Create new experiment
3. Leave name blank
4. Enter valid URL
5. Save

Test Case Description: Verify invalid URL is rejected during experiment creation
Test Steps:
1. Login
2. Create new experiment
3. Enter valid name
4. Enter malformed URL
5. Save

Test Case Description: Verify maximum number of variations can be added and boundary enforced
Test Steps:
1. Login
2. Create experiment
3. Add variations until max limit
4. Attempt additional variation

Test Case Description: Verify audience targeting by browser type applies correctly
Test Steps:
1. Open experiment
2. Navigate to targeting
3. Add browser rule
4. Save
5. Confirm rule present

Test Case Description: Verify country segmentation works for selected region
Test Steps:
1. Open experiment
2. Add country filter
3. Save
4. Validate filter in summary

Test Case Description: Verify invalid audience criteria input is rejected
Test Steps:
1. Open targeting settings
2. Enter invalid rule value
3. Save

Test Case Description: Verify variation can be added to an experiment
Test Steps:
1. Open existing experiment
2. Add new variation
3. Enter valid variation name
4. Save

Test Case Description: Verify variation preview displays expected content
Test Steps:
1. Open variation settings
2. Click Preview
3. Confirm preview loads

Test Case Description: Verify variation deletion removes it from experiment setup
Test Steps:
1. Open experiment
2. Delete variation
3. Confirm removal

Test Case Description: Verify experiment can be started successfully
Test Steps:
1. Open created experiment
2. Click Start/Run
3. Confirm status changes to Running

Test Case Description: Verify experiment can be stopped/paused successfully
Test Steps:
1. Start experiment
2. Click Stop/Pause
3. Confirm status changes

Test Case Description: Verify experiment status reflects current lifecycle state
Test Steps:
1. View experiment list
2. Confirm status label for Running, Paused, Draft

Test Case Description: Verify experiment results dashboard displays experiment metrics
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to Reports
2. Select active experiment
3. Confirm metrics display

Test Case Description: Verify conversion count updates after valid event data
Test Steps:
1. Run experiment
2. Generate test conversion event
3. Confirm count increments

Test Case Description: Verify empty report state displays appropriate message when no data exists
Test Steps:
1. Open report for new experiment with no traffic
2. Confirm no-data message

Test Case Description: Verify admin user has full access to all experiment actions
Test Steps:
1. Login as admin
2. Navigate experiments
3. Verify create/edit/delete/start/stop privileges

Test Case Description: Verify editor user can edit experiments but cannot perform admin-only actions
Test Steps:
1. Login as editor
2. Open experiment
3. Verify edit actions allowed, admin actions restricted

Test Case Description: Verify viewer user can view experiment details only
Test Steps:
1. Login as viewer
2. Open experiment
3. Confirm edit controls unavailable

Test Case Description: Verify guest or unknown role is denied access or redirected appropriately
Test Steps:
1. Login as guest/invalid role
2. Attempt access
3. Confirm access denied message
